metadata.description: Five living looks for Claude Code on desktop: animated scenes that show you the session.

plugins.name: abyss
plugins.description: A living ocean behind Claude Code: your context window is the depth. The longer the session, the deeper and darker the water. /compact to surface.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: A smithy fire behind Claude Code that you keep alive: every prompt is a strike that feeds it, and it burns down to embers when you drift off.

plugins.name: horizon
plugins.description: A mountain sky behind Claude Code that keeps your local time: dawn, noon, dusk, then stars and northern lights. It tells you when to take a break and when to call it a night.

plugins.name: arcade
plugins.description: A neon grid behind Claude Code that keeps score: every tool call scores, clean runs build a combo, every turn is a stage, and your hi-score survives the session.

plugins.name: enso
plugins.description: An ink-wash garden behind Claude Code with a focus timer you can see: /enso 25 and a brush circle paints itself over 25 minutes. When it closes, the sitting is done.
